# CodeToolPicker — full text
Independent AI coding tool comparison. Source: https://patwinplastics.github.io/codetoolpicker/ . Data checked 2026-10-15; confirm prices on vendor sites.

## Cursor
- tagline: AI-first IDE with agents, cloud agents, and multi-model chat
- category: ai-ide
- formFactor: Desktop IDE
- models: Grok + Composer included; Claude/GPT/Gemini via prepaid credit on Premium+
- bestFor: Daily coding in a full IDE with agents and cloud work
- strengths: ["Full IDE", "Cloud agents", "Strong agent workflows", "Multi-model (Premium+)"]
- plan Free: $0/mo — Limited usage
- plan Plus: $8/mo — Cursor/Grok models only
- plan Premium: $30/mo — 4x Plus + third-party models at API price
- plan Super: $100/mo — 15x Plus
- plan Ultra: $200/mo — 50x Plus

## GitHub Copilot
- tagline: AI pair programmer inside VS Code, JetBrains, and GitHub
- category: ai-ide
- formFactor: IDE extension + GitHub
- models: Selection of models; premium models on higher tiers
- bestFor: GitHub-centric teams who want completions plus chat and agents
- strengths: ["Deep GitHub integration", "Works in many IDEs", "Team admin controls", "Usage-based credits"]
- plan Free: $0/mo — Limited AI credits, auto model only
- plan Pro: $10/mo — 1,500 AI credits / mo
- plan Pro+: $39/mo — 7,000 AI credits / mo
- plan Max: $100/mo — 20,000 AI credits / mo
- plan Business: $19/mo — Per seat, 1,900 credits

## Claude Code
- tagline: Anthropic's terminal and IDE coding agent
- category: agent
- formFactor: Terminal / IDE agent
- models: Claude Sonnet, Opus, and related Claude models
- bestFor: Terminal-native agentic coding on Claude models
- strengths: ["Strong reasoning models", "Terminal-first agent", "Shared plan with Claude chat"]
- plan Pro: $20/mo — Claude Code included; shared usage pool
- plan Max 5x: $100/mo — 5x Pro usage
- plan Max 20x: $200/mo — 20x Pro usage

## Windsurf
- tagline: AI IDE with Cascade agent and cloud agents (Devin Cloud)
- category: ai-ide
- formFactor: Desktop IDE
- models: Frontier OpenAI, Claude, Gemini + SWE models
- bestFor: Engineers who want a Cursor-class IDE with Cascade multi-step agents
- strengths: ["Cascade agent", "Cloud agents", "Competitive Pro price", "Extra usage at API price"]
- plan Free: $0/mo — Light daily/weekly quota
- plan Pro: $20/mo — Standard quota + frontier models
- plan Max: $200/mo — Heavy quota
- plan Teams: $40/mo — Per seat

## Lovable
- tagline: Chat-to-app builder for shipping web apps fast
- category: builder
- formFactor: Browser builder
- models: Managed builder models
- bestFor: Non-engineers and vibe coders who want a working web app from chat
- strengths: ["Fast chat-to-app", "Hosting included", "Great for prototypes", "Affiliate-friendly category"]
- plan Free: $0/mo — 5 daily build credits (capped monthly)
- plan Paid: $25/mo — From ~$25/mo; credit-based (check live page)

## Bolt.new
- tagline: In-browser AI app builder on StackBlitz WebContainers
- category: builder
- formFactor: Browser IDE / builder
- models: Managed builder models
- bestFor: Code-visible chat-to-app with real project files in the browser
- strengths: ["Real code in browser", "Hosting + DB options", "Token rollover on paid", "Affiliate potential"]
- plan Free: $0/mo — 300K tokens/day, 1M/mo, Bolt branding
- plan Pro: $25/mo — From 10M tokens/mo, custom domain, no branding
- plan Teams: $30/mo — Per member / mo
